name: SpareBank 1 Sør-Norge ASA
note: Norwegian savings-bank group, allmennaksjeselskap (Brønnøysund orgnr 937 895 321), headquartered in Stavanger; formed when SpareBank 1 SR-Bank and SpareBank 1 Sørøst-Norge merged on 1 October 2024. Its own page says seven sparebankstiftelser (savings-bank foundations) own around 45 percent; its shareholding register as of 31 December 2025 lists Sparebankstiftelsen Sr-Bank (20.95%), Sparebank 1 Stiftelsen Bv (8.70%), Folketrygdfondet (6.94%) and Sparebankstiftelsen Telemark (6.67%) as the largest holders. No state or state-fund controlling stake.
